messages.subject: [Basta-users] BaSTA not available
messages.body_plain:
Dear Fernando,

	Thank you for your message about updating to Basta 1.5

	I get the following error: 

 >  install.packages("BaSTA", repos = "http://R-Forge.R-project.org", type = "source")
Warning message:
package ?BaSTA? is not available (for R version 2.15.1) 


	I got similar errors before i updated R to 2.15, it would simply say not available.

	Installing from CRAN works fine.

	Thanks!
	
	All the best!

   	Cliff Cunningham
